exitCriteria.title: One account cannot read another account’s saved areas, proven by a test that attempts it directly against the database
exitCriteria.reason: The local policy filters by owner, but no managed Canadian database, row-level-security policy, or direct database isolation test exists. A policy-only test cannot prove database tenant isolation.

exitCriteria.title: Account deletion removes saved areas and personal data within 30 days, proven by a test
exitCriteria.reason: The deterministic local store policy removes the account, its saved areas, and its alert history at the 30-day deadline; the focused test exercises that boundary. This is local policy evidence only, not proof of a hosted deletion operation.

exitCriteria.title: The kill switch stops all outbound alerts within 5 minutes
exitCriteria.reason: The pure evaluator honours a local kill-switch flag, but no outbound queue or sender exists and no independent timed rehearsal has been observed. A unit test cannot establish a five-minute operational stop.

exitCriteria.title: Every alert template carries its evidence class, data version, source agency and observation time
exitCriteria.reason: The local evaluator refuses incomplete event metadata and constructs every bilingual payload with evidence-first-line text, data version, source agency, and observation time. The focused test exercises all seven trigger templates and required fields.

exitCriteria.title: A correction to a published figure produces a correction alert to everyone previously notified
exitCriteria.reason: The local policy selects every history entry for a restated figure and the evaluator permits correction alerts only for a previously notified saved area. Focused tests cover changed-only correction recipients and rejection of an unnotified correction.

activationBlockers.reason: No Canadian managed account database, encryption-at-rest verification, or direct database row-level-security isolation test has been provisioned or admitted.
The plan requires an independent live test of both deletion and the under-five-minute kill switch; no sender, queue, or independent rehearsal evidence exists.
Privacy, security, and legal review—including reviewed English/French template and consent wording—remain external approval gates.

localOnlyBoundary: No real personal data is stored and no outbound alert is sent. The default-closed activation guard prevents local policy evidence from activating an account service.
